name: Ramos-Jimenez et al. / PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET
title: A collection of maximal cardiorespiratory exercise tests on treadmill
provenance_notes: Continuous breath-by-breath VO2 (mL/min), VCO2 (mL/min), HR, and treadmill speed (km/h) across N=992 maximal incremental exercise tests on N=857 independent participants (575,087 total observations). N=981 valid incremental tests on N=846 unique participants admitted for subject-level GroupKFold validation (116 repeat subjects with 251 tests preserved). Downloaded from PhysioNet AWS S3 open mirror; SHA256 checksums verified against official SHA256SUMS.txt. Note: license conflict tracked under ISS-0020 (packaged CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 vs PhysioNet Health Data License 1.5.0).

name: Hug et al. (2015) / Dryad Individual Muscle Architecture & Torque
title: Data from: Individual muscle contribution to knee flexion and extension torque
provenance_notes: Dryad data package containing 5 raw XLSX files across N=21 participants (Muscle_Architecture.xlsx, Torque_and_VA.xlsx, EMG.xlsx, etc.). Package metadata and PMC publication verified; automated unattended CLI downloads are blocked by Dryad Cloudflare/Anubis BotStopper interactive challenge (HTTP 401 on API / interactive HTML challenge on file stream). Retained as verified metadata anchor.
